text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mommy, over here, over here!! Closer! 
Let's get closer-!!

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
Look, the winning Umamusume is going to 
speak! The Oaks Umamusume is gonna talk!!

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
(That person from before... who ran so 
beautifully, looking just like that 
Umamusume from the past...!)

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I want to dedicate this victory... to the 
Master who guided me here."

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'll sprint through the Tiara route just 
like this, and one day, I too will—"

text_block_list.name: Oaks Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Just like my mentor. I will become an 
Umamusume who can pass on her teachings to 
those who follow after!

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text: Waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――"Tiara Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That refers to the girls among the racing 
Umamusume who yearned for the radiance of 
the "Tiara"!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to claim the Triple Tiara 
comprising the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho, or to be 
crowned in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and 
Victoria Mile—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She isn't just strong. She's lovely, 
brilliant, and captivates everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about—the cool seniors!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: From here on, I will too—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, an open campus event is being held 
at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, the academy grounds were 
overflowing with young Umamusume dreaming 
of one day running in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, little ponies! Are you ready to 
listen to my story?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And now! Here come the Tiara Umamusume~!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah! Amazing!! It's the real deal! So 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...Ehehe. Calling me 'wonderful', of 
all things...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Flower, don't be shy; hold your head 
high. To these children, you are 
undeniably one of the Umamusume they look 
up to."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now then... First, let us move on to 
introductions. I am Air Groove. I serve as 
the student council vice president at 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Her major achievements in racing are—

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, pick me! The Oaks! The Oaks is super 
famous for being won across two 
generations, mother and daughter!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~! Really?! You know so much, Big 
Sis!

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. ...And the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too! 
With that victory, Air Groove was chosen 
as Horse Girl of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Only the second horse girl in history from 
the Tiara route to become Umamusume of the 
Year! Ahh... it was so, sooooo amazing!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-well then... me too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello, everyone. My name is Nishino 
Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was able to win the Oka Sho... 
thanks to so many people!

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it, I saw it! Following up on the 
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, the Oka Sho 
entered as the first favorite...!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, number one! They said I was the most 
amazing! So cool, so cooool!

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Flower-san shoulders huge 
expectations on her small shoulders and 
puts on such an amazing run—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No, wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My, how enthusiastic.

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah-wah-wah!? Eh, eh, eh, Mejiro 
Ramonu-san!?

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaa...! No way, to think I'd get to 
hear from the first Umamusume ever to 
achieve the Triple Tiara...!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait. ...Just wait!

text_block_list.name: Strangely Knowledgeable Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Rhein Kraft. This is a talk show for 
the open campus visitors, you know."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehe~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Leave the room immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Auu~! I got kicked out...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! U-Uhm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help myself... Thinking I might 
get to hear stories from the Tiara 
Umamusume I look up to so much made me so 
excited... Tee-hee.
choice_data_list:
I don't think sneaking in is a good 
idea...
I don't think we should be sneaking in...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because! A lineup like that is 
super-duper rare, isn't it?! All of them 
being Tiara route legends—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I can understand your feelings. 
However, what good is it if you forget 
your own duty?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: !? Huh, Cesario?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(She is Cesario. Same school year, same 
class, debuted in the same period... and 
what's more, my roommate at the dorm!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(She's great at teaching studies and 
making sweets. When we're in the room, 
she's especially gentle—such a sweet, 
fluffy Umamusume, but—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Cesario looks really sharp and composed 
right now, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. We must properly "switch gears" 
according to the situation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With a race coming up, it's only natural 
that one can't afford to be gentle.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, Craft. Seeing as your 
exhibition race against them is about to 
begin.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……? Exhi... bition?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah!
choice_data_list: Go change your clothes quickly, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees---!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...There are less than 10 minutes until 
horses are scheduled to enter the gates.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Don't tell me Craft isn't 
planning on showing up at all?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Who can say? ...Either way, I shall simply 
fulfill my duty.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, I'm with you! I agree. If they 
aren't coming, then whatever—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm just going to steal the spotlight in 
the race, that's all.
choice_data_list:
(If I remember right, we ran together 
during the selection race too—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Cesario, Air Messiah and Daring 
Heart are also in the same grade, the same 
class, and part of the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As they steadily prepared for the 
exhibition race, finally—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, wheeze*...! S-Sorry to keep 
you waiting...!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm Rhein Kraft! I'll be running in the 
exhibition race!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario! And Messiah-san, Heart-san too! 
Let's have a great time today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just made it in the nick of time! Or 
perhaps you were just showing off how 
big-time you are?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh! N-No way!? I didn't mean that at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I bet!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—You've always been a big deal. You didn't 
need to go out of your way to show off.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your high potential goes without saying. 
Even so, I have no intention of flinching 
or losing to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the purpose of this 
exhibition?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems the theme is 'To showcase the 
brilliance of future Tiara umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, this might just be the 
beginning of our battle in the Classic 
division... along the Triple Tiara route."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...And precisely because of that, 
naturally, I cannot afford to lose."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That she herself is the one worthy of 
being crowned with the next Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I shall show you. Right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft. ...She is the Umamusume I 
train. Normally, she's gentle and does 
things at her own pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running overflowed with raw talent, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"No! I'm the one who's taking the Triple 
Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: To no one. I won't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strong, unyielding longing for the 
Triple Tiara route burns brightly in her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's time. Let's go, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —It's on!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Strong, elegant, and brilliant, they race 
across the turf."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart fluttered involuntarily. I 
couldn't help but be utterly captivated.
choice_data_list:
These are the Tiara Umamusume of the next 
generation—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft is surrounded by flowers that 
are magnificent, yet fierce. Yet, no 
matter what era she finds herself in—
choice_data_list:
Let's win and make that dream come 
true—together with her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ……And once more, I renewed that vow.
